bayts.text: Grant relief, by the rank of the Chosen One, to his community, O You Who drew such-and-such a servant out of his distress.
Write blessing and peace for the Prophet, with the Family and the Companions, those who keep away (from evil).
Keep safe, by his rank and their rank together, his community, O One Who subdued (the enemies) for me.
Bestow by grace upon the believers a relief, O Giver of safety.
O Beautiful (Al-Jamīl), make the safety of the Lord of the worlds reach all Muslim men and women.
Write purity for all men and women who do good, O Protector of the believers.
By (the Name of) Allah, the All-Merciful and the Most Merciful, grant those who love You what effaces fear.
By Your noble Face, turn a relief without harm toward those who persevere in hope.
Grant those who have faith and Islam the best of glad tidings, without blame.
You have effaced the harm of Your servant, the Khadīm, O best of those who bestow by setting foremost.
You have raised his striving to You, O Appreciative (Ash-Shakūr), with generosity, favour and gratitude.
By the right of Your noble Face, grant him an answer, O You Who have effaced his chains.
By Allah, the All-Merciful and the Most Merciful, O He Who has been named the Near (Al-Qarīb) and the Responsive (Al-Mujīb).
Grant those who have believed and submitted separation from the (seductive) trial of those who have done wrong.
blessing and greeting the Messenger with his party, O He Who has favoured me with what I asked.
